boss:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production transparent sprite atlas for a cheerful hand-painted 2D chibi rescue game. Create ONE 3-column by 2-row sprite sheet, landscape 1536x1024, six equal square cells. Each cell contains ONE full body version of the SAME Pigment Queen flower boss, centered with feet at 90% cell height, entire silhouette safely inside cell with generous transparent margin, no overlap across cells. True transparent background, no grid, no text, no shadows outside character, no ground.
Character: formidable but cute dark-purple flower queen with huge layered black-plum lotus petal crown, small golden crescent diadem, pearl lavender face, large expressive eyes, silver freckles, mint-green leaf arms, two small leaf feet and layered charcoal-purple petal dress; pearlescent violet faceted gem socket in lower chest. Two arms and two feet only. No resemblance to a round green gravity monster. Friendly polished storybook illustration, bold clean dark contours, soft painted shading, readable at small game scale. Deep purple identity remains after rescue.
Read order: top left idle closed shell, calm stern face and lower petals firmly covering dark chest socket; top middle clearly raised BOTH leaf hands casting/charging spell with concentrated expression, shell closed; top right shield posture with both arms spread and closed flower shell, suspicious face; bottom left core exposed, lower chest petals spread LEFT and RIGHT to reveal a luminous pale violet diamond centered at 60% cell height, tired face and lowered arms; bottom middle hit/recoil face eyes squeezed, lower shell opened, diamond visible, arms recoiling, feet stay on same baseline; bottom right freed smiling eyes, relieved smile, open petals, two leaf hands happily extended, retains dark-purple dress and crown. No spell beams, no floating extra objects, no backgrounds. All six poses have same crown/face/dress size and consistent foot alignment. Keep the queen width less than 70% of each cell, height around 80%.
enemies:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one transparent small-enemy sprite atlas for a polished hand-painted chibi 2D rescue game. Landscape 1536x1024, strict 3 columns x 2 rows of six equal 512 square cells, full isolated characters centered in each cell, generous empty margins, all feet aligned at 90% of cell height. Absolutely transparent background and no haze, no cast shadow, no background gradients, no words, no grid lines. Bold charcoal contours, pearl violet highlights, plum-black bodies and pale mint leaves.
Each COLUMN is one distinct creature species, not a miniature flower queen:
Column 1 inkDrop: pear-shaped shiny black-purple INK DROPLET with a single curved mint leaf sprout, wide expressive eyes, tiny leaf arms and exactly TWO short feet, friendly mischievous face. Readable droplet silhouette.
Column 2 inkRoller: wide ROUND faceted dark-amethyst crystal hedgehog ball with FIVE blunt crystal spikes, pale angular brow and expressive eyes, tiny TWO feet, NO flower crown or dress, tough compact silhouette. Body noticeably wider than droplet.
Column 3 inkPlanter: squat pale mint ceramic flowerpot creature with dark-purple leafy flower tuft, large eyes, TWO feet and two leaf arms, holding ONE small purple seed in one hand. Flowerpot ceramic body visibly pale mint, dark-purple foliage top; very different from both other creatures.
TOP ROW: calm walking/idle pose for each species, exact foot baseline, arms relaxed.
BOTTOM ROW: attack anticipation/action pose for same respective species. Droplet crouches with narrowed eyes and leaf arms drawn back for a hop; crystal ball braces into compact spinning posture with stern eyes; flowerpot extends its seed hand and leans forward planting. Same creature identity, palette, body size and foot registration in both rows. NO other characters, no effects or loose objects outside the silhouettes. Match elegant painted game sprites, not vector circles, not horror. Keep each character height about 65% cell height and width less than 70%.
props:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE production prop sprite atlas for a hand-painted chibi flower-garden rescue game. A landscape 1536x1024 image split into THREE equal vertical columns. Exactly one full object centered in each column with large transparent margins, object height about 60% of image. All three objects share the polished dark-purple/plum, lavender crystal and mint-leaf aesthetic. Actual transparent background, NO background color, haze, cast shadow, labels, grid or text. Strong clean outlines and painted dimensional shading.
LEFT column: dangerous ink crystal flower growing out of a small dark-plum lotus rosette, a single tall faceted dark purple crystal at the center, two smaller side shards and two mint leaves at the base, angular pointed silhouette. No eyes, no character, no base pedestal, no ring.
MIDDLE column: shield ink crystal flower, same tall dark-plum crystal with pale lavender facets, surrounded by four thick curled black-purple protective lotus petals opened sideways around it and two mint leaves at the base, clearly a more armored version. No energy dome or outer effects.
RIGHT column: collectable freed pigment flower CORE, an elegant symmetrical six-petal dark-plum lotus rosette enclosing a luminous pearl lavender faceted diamond with silver edge, small mint leaf pair below and a tiny gold crescent ornament above. Visibly precious and distinct from the jagged hazard crystals, purple identity unchanged after rescue. No halo, no ring, no star effects, no floating fragments. Each complete object fully inside its column, no overlap. These are a sprite atlas to crop and pack for runtime, so preserve true alpha and generous separation.
map:
Use case: lighting-weather. Asset type: existing 1024x1536 portrait 2D game map recolor for Black Garden Calamity. Input image is the EDIT TARGET. Edit ONLY surface colors and lighting in the supplied map, keeping the exact map composition and every silhouette/position/size unchanged. Preserve ALL paths, intersections, path borders, stairs, bridges, stone patterns, three buildings, café tables, umbrellas, lampposts, planters, arches, fences, rocks, streams, tree trunks, every existing obstruction and camera angle pixel-aligned with the original. No new obstacles or objects, no shifts, no redrawing geometry, no widening or narrowing paths.
Recolor the same garden into an enchanted black-purple flower garden under dusky moonlight. Existing flowers become rich dark plum, lilac and silver-violet flowers; existing grass becomes muted deep teal/olive with subtle lavender light; existing tree canopies become deep jade and cool blue-green. The three buildings retain their exact roofs/facades but receive cool dusk shading and warm golden window/lantern light. Existing main cream-stone walkways remain clearly readable and relatively BRIGHT pale lavender/ivory so a small purple boss and blue player can be seen. Streams stay cool blue. A quiet magical mood with crisp painted details and no heavy fog obscuring the map. Friendly storybook game art matching source, not horror. No characters, no boss, no crystal hazards, no text, no UI, no extra lights or particles. Fill the image edge to edge, opaque background, same exact 2:3 portrait framing and original layout. This must match the existing game's collision geometry.
